coord_source: Abbas (ed.) 2014 p.iii: 'koordinat sekitar S7 15 07.0 dan E110 01 37.4' (converted to decimal degrees)
habitation_evidence: Excavated 2010-2016. Charred wooden stilt-house remains with woven-bamboo walls and thatch (ijuk); rows of square (timber) and round (bamboo) post-hole features 10-15 cm wide, 20-30 cm deep with organic charcoal; stone-paved yards/paths; Chinese (Tang-type) ceramics and local earthenware (jars, bowls, kendi, periuk), metal and stone household/tool items; charred rice grains reported from the habitation area; buffalo bone with butchery/consumption taphonomy (2016 season). Same site also has temples, batur and agricultural terraces. CAVEAT: the monograph itself notes the row of stilt buildings in 'Ruang C1' may have been dharmasala (ritual-support) rather than dwellings; the 'area hunian' is nonetheless described by the excavators as domestic (houses + household pottery).
dating_basis: Ceramics (Chinese Tang-period, 9th-10th c.) + temple-base profile style; 14C on bamboo and wood charcoal from several contexts 2011-2014, reported only as calendar years 587, 742, 846, 913, 971 CE (no lab codes or sigmas in the text I read; the 2011 bamboo-charcoal sample is given as 1060 +/-110 BP converted to 971 CE with a web calibrator). A human-skeleton matrix sample gave 312 BCE and is explicitly treated as discordant.
date_range_ce: c. 8th-10th c. CE for the main occupation (ceramics 9th-10th c.; 14C calendar ages 742-971 CE); one 14C age 587 CE (6th c.) suggests earlier occupation
depth_m: 6-10 m total volcanic cover (Abbas ed. 2014 p.iii: 6-9; Riyanto 2013:767 as quoted: 6-10; geology chapter: pyroclastic fall+flow 4-7 m locally)
reason: Open-air habitation deposit (house frames, post-holes, domestic pottery/ceramics, food remains) with ceramic + 14C dating in the 8th-10th c. CE window. Caveats recorded: calibrated ages have no lab codes in the sources read; the C1 stilt-house row may be ritual support; site includes temples (allowed by the definition).

(ed.) 2014 Liangan: Mozaik Peradaban Mataram Kuno di Lereng Sindoro (Kepel Press) [pp. iii-iv, 44, 58, 76, 101-102]; Riyanto, S. 2015 Situs Liangan: Ragam Data, Kronologi, dan Aspek Keruangan, Berkala Arkeologi 35(1):33-58; Noerwidi, S. 2017 Eksploitasi Fauna di Situs Liangan, Temanggung, Berkala Arkeologi 37(1):35-50
